profile.headline: Forward-deployed engineering & applied AI · Agentic coding · Microsoft stack · Engineering leader · Conference speaker
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, then CISO and Director of Business Development
profile.summary:
I'm an engineer who can run a sales call. Twenty years hands-on across healthcare, fintech, utilities and public sector: Veradigm, Envestnet, NetApp, Itron. I still write production code.

Along the way I bought and ran a digital marketing agency, full P&L, and spoke at more than ten technical conferences, including CodeMash, DevTeach Montreal and Prairie Dev Con. Applied AI is where the attention goes now: an AI agent in production, an engineering team moved onto Claude Code and Codex, and side projects that ship.

The work I like best is being the technical person in the room with the customer.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, then CISO and Director of Business Development
positions.locationName: Cary, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Seven-person public-health SaaS serving state, federal and international health agencies. Joined as a senior software engineer; took on security and compliance as CISO, then business development.
• Architected, coded and led delivery of a production HL7 FHIR integration with the CDC's National Center for Health Statistics for birth and  fetal death reporting.
• Built an AI agent that scores inbound RFPs against fit criteria before anyone reads them, cutting a week's solicitations to a handful worth a real look.
• Brought agentic coding to the engineering team with Claude Code and Codex, from design through test generation and code review.
• Managed projects across engineering and customer delivery: requirements, priorities, testing and outside stakeholders.
• Took the company through SOC 2 Type I within 90 days of hire and Type II in December 2025 under a continuous-audit model, stood up the HIPAA program, and ran the managed-services function.
positions.insights: Skills: SOC 2 · Cybersecurity · Engineering · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Large Language Models (LLM)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer (acting Engineering Manager)
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description: Veradigm makes EHR, analytics, and connectivity software for healthcare providers, payers, and life sciences. I acted as engineering manager for most of my time there, building risk adjustment and compliance reporting tools. I also worked on the Azure migration strategy for claims, Medicare, and quality data.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Management · Scaled Agile Framework · Azure DevOps Server · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer
positions.description: I raised investor capital and used SBA financing to buy a digital marketing agency serving home services businesses. About $1M in revenue, 5 employees in house and 10 offshore. I ran sales, delivery, account management, and vendor relationships.
positions.insights: Skills: P&L Management · Business Acquisition · Go-to-Market Strategy

positions.title: Director of Engineering
positions.description: Envestnet is a FinTech that sells wealth management software to financial institutions and advisors. I ran two engineering teams across multiple time zones, owning the core data services behind the Tamarac portfolio suite, an ETL platform drawing on over 10,000 data sources and 1,000 custodial feeds. I handled release planning, production triage, and code review, and managed the interview process for several teams in the division.
positions.insights: Skills: Mentoring · Engineering Leadership · Lean Software Development · Engineering Management · Team Management

positions.title: Cloud Performance Automation Engineer Lead
positions.description: NetApp sells data storage and cloud data infrastructure to enterprises. I was one of their first cloud engineering hires, working on an initiative to get the flagship product running on public cloud. I built a single-click, end-to-end load testing suite for Cloud Volumes ONTAP in Python, running on Azure, AWS, and GCP. I also managed an offshore team of five in India.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description:
For over a decade, I provided software development services to multiple clients that included Accuweather, CDN Publishing, TowerCo, Stephen Cole Consulting, NC AccessCare, NC Dept. of Agriculture, and others. 

Selected Engagements:
Broadvine (2021) - I served as Director of Software Engineering for a provider of a cloud-based financial management and performance reporting solution for the hospitality industry, with efforts focused on setting development standards and preparing the organization for sale. The company was acquired within my first six months. 

Peoplefluent (2014 - 2015) - I was engaged as a Software Applications Architect in a hybrid management/full-stack developer role responsible for setting project direction and leading delivery of an applicant tracking system built on C#/.NET. 

Parata Systems (2014) On this engagement I was responsible for leading and mentoring a project team in database development, data architecture, integration development, requirements identifications, and testing. Technical work included solution architecture and planned development of a greenfield flagship product (portable drug device), and planning for backend cloud-based deployment for AWS hosting, built in C#, MVC5, Entity Framework 6, SQL Server.

Geico Insurance (2011 - 2013) At Geico I was a member of an architecture/R&D team that built a reference software architecture as a pattern for all Geico developers. We developed reusable assets such as solution architectures (physical and logical), and leveraged Azure Cloud environment (IAAS) for hosting/test/deployment environment. The assignment also included work with MongoDB and Neo4J

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer/Technical Program Manager
positions.description: Itron builds systems that measure and manage energy and water use for utilities and cities. I was a hands on architect and program manager on a two year, $30M program for the largest utility in the Southeast, running a team of seventeen across the US and India. I architected a greenfield IoT asset tracking platform on Azure Service Fabric, led the redesign of the utility meter analytics portal, and moved the group off waterfall onto a DevOps model.

honors.title: TechJam Contest Winner
honors.description: Team of four developers participated in a 36 hour Hackathon style event and won for our solution in the Predictive Analysis category. We used VS 2012, .NET 4.5/C#, ASP.NET MVC4, Azure Cloud Services, MongoDB and F#.

projects.title: BattleHack Raleigh 2015
projects.description:
Team Forgone Conclusion developing an app to "Earn cash for driving safely, paid by members that don't." 

BattleHack started in 2013 and is organized by PayPal and Braintree, a PayPal company.
